summary: Explains requirements for and submits requests for fix-and-flip loan term sheets for 1-4 unit investment properties, emailed to the investor.
whenToUse: Use when a real estate investor wants an indicative term sheet for a business-purpose fix-and-flip loan.
flags: Tool description contains a 'Reviewer mode' note about example.com/example.org email addresses, which reads like instructions aimed at automated reviewers
